verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a first-party interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. The only related item is the reference page's description of Postman, a third-party tool for building and sending requests. That is an adjacent external workaround, not Mercado Pago's own interactive reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Postman is a tool that simplifies API development, testing, and documenting, allowing you to create and share requests quickly and securely.
